blends.name: 30x Materials Crate > 1x Materials Crate II
blends.desc:
By combining 30 Rustveil Materials Crates, each packed with 3 random crafting NFTs, blacksmiths forge a single Materials Crate II — a massive container brimming with the essence of ninety refined components. Within its reinforced shell lies a storm of rare alloys and elemental fragments, each piece holding greater value and potential rewards.

The result: one powerful crate containing 90 random Material NFTs, forged from the fusion of countless lesser crates.

blends.name: 30x Spirit Capsule > 1x Spirit Capsule II
blends.desc:
By merging 30 Spirit Capsule Packs, each containing 3 mysterious NFTs, alchemists forge a single Spirit Capsule II — a grand containment vessel infused with the essence of ninety bound spirits. Within its crystalline core swirls a storm of condensed soul energy, each fragment resonating with higher rarity and greater potential rewards. 

The result: one powerful pack holding 90 random NFTs, born from the fusion of countless lesser capsules.
